recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the already-applied FHIR-20497 terminology refresh for the remaining Procedure status prose without changing the normative status code system or revisiting the related Procedure.statusReason binding decision.
issue_request: FHIR-20497 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested updating Procedure.status examples from STU3/R3 suspended and aborted terms to the current on-hold and stopped terms, with a resolution to update the Procedure.status short description.
initial_application: The Jira-linked merge 88c604c66b028201ee797438b5154f3366ee7ec0, via implementation commit cff3828142337a515ea4a2fe0e509120467d8f0f, updated the Procedure.status short description and recorded GF#20497. Current Procedure.status retained that corrected short description, but the adjacent Procedure.statusReason comment still used the retired suspended and aborted examples.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini, and Procedure.status is required-bound to ValueSet/event-status. The current Event Status code system includes on-hold and stopped, not suspended or aborted. FHIR-14869 confirms Procedure.statusReason prose is intended to describe exception status reason capture and that its value-set binding remains example strength. Exact Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct conflicting community record.
